texts.title: Oakley Leisure Centre — new membership options

paragraphs.text: From 1 October, Oakley Leisure Centre will offer three types of membership. Standard membership, at £32 a month, includes the gym, the swimming pool and all fitness classes.

Off-peak membership costs £22 a month and gives the same access, but only between 10 am and 4 pm on weekdays and at any time at weekends. Swim-only membership costs £18 a month and includes lane swimming at any time.
All members can bring a guest for £5 per visit. Children under 12 are not allowed in the gym, but they may use the pool with an adult.
Existing members will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September. Members can change their membership type once every three months.
The centre’s café, on the first floor, is open to members and non-members from 8 am to 8 pm. Members receive a ten per cent discount on hot drinks.
Check-in is from 3 pm and check-out is by 11 am. Guests who need to leave later can ask reception for a late check-out, which is free until 1 pm if rooms are available.
Breakfast is served in the restaurant from 7 am to 10 am and is included in all room rates. Guests who leave before 7 am can order a breakfast bag the evening before.
The hotel has a small gym on the lower ground floor, open 24 hours, and a spa that must be booked in advance. Towels for the spa are provided, but guests should bring their own swimwear.
Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The car park is free for guests but has only 20 spaces, so it is not possible to reserve a space in advance.
Pets are not allowed in the hotel, except for assistance dogs. If you expect to arrive after 10 pm, please let reception know when you book.
